name: HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd
about: HDFC Life Insurance Company is engaged in carrying on the business of life insurance. The Company offers a range of individual and group insurance solutions. The portfolio comprises of various insurance and investment products such as Protection, Pension, Savings,(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No: 175)
keyPoints: Parentage HDFC Bank, the promoter group, holds 50.25% stake as of Q2 FY26. As India’s largest private sector bank by balance sheet size, HBL and its subsidiaries offer a wide array of financial services, including non-banking financial services, insurance, asset management, and broking. [1] [2] [3]
pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 25.3%
cons: Stock is trading at 6.57 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.81% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 11.1% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1,021 Cr.
